enabled.description: Synchronise the system clock once the network is up

server.description: Primary NTP server. A .local name works if mDNS is running.

server_fallback.description: Secondary NTP server; empty to use only the primary

sync_interval_ms.description: How often to re-synchronise once the first sync succeeds (ms)

timezone.description: POSIX TZ string, e.g. 'EST5EDT,M3.2.0,M11.1.0'. Applied to the C library, so localtime() and strftime() honour it.
